Resolutions of 1979

18 resolutions, 17% unanimous. Late Cold War.

  • 444 (1979) Renewing the mandate of the UN Interim Force in Lebanon
  • 445 (1979) Condemning Southern Rhodesia's armed invasions of Angola, Mozambique and Zambia
  • 446 (1979) Establishment of a commission to examine the situation relating to settlements in the Arab territories occupied by Israel
  • 447 (1979) South Africa's policies towards Angola and other front-line States
  • 448 (1979) Reaffirming the April 1979 elections and the results thereof in Southern Rhodesia to be null and void
  • 449 (1979) Renewal of the mandate of the UN Disengagement Observer Force
  • 450 (1979) Renewing the mandate of the UN Interim Force in Lebanon
  • 451 (1979) Extending the stationing in Cyprus of the UN Peace-keeping Force
  • 452 (1979) Israeli settlement policies in the occupied territories
  • 453 (1979) Admission of Saint Lucia to membership in the United Nations
  • 454 (1979) South Africa's policies towards Angola and other front-line States
  • 455 (1979) Southern Rhodesia's policies towards Zambia
  • 456 (1979) Renewal of the mandate of the UN Disengagement Observer Force
  • 457 (1979) Diplomatic relations between Iran and the United States
  • 458 (1979) Extending the stationing in Cyprus of the UN Peace-keeping Force
  • 459 (1979) Extension of the mandate of the UN Interim Force in Lebanon
  • 460 (1979) The termination of sanctions against Southern Rhodesia
  • 461 (1979) Detention of persons of United States nationality in Iran

Security Council Record is an independent record of every resolution, vote and veto of the United Nations Security Council since 1946. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the United Nations. For official documents, use the Security Council website and the UN Digital Library.
